mainText: Hello, Verona! At 12 PM, here is today's balanced dish: we have overcast skies and a mild 67 degrees at Fireman's Park, with a waning gibbous moon phase currently in the sky.

In city news, a portion of Hwy M near the future Aldi site will be closed for road construction from October 6 through October 9. Also, early in-person absentee voting for the November 3 election begins on October 20 at City Hall.

It is a busy week in Verona! Today you can enjoy the downtown Farmer's Market, Yoga at Insight Wellness, or Wednesday pizza at Lake Lou-ee. Tomorrow, make sure to check out the Art Bar happy hour or Hop Haus trivia.
Reflecting on our weekly report, on September 21, an individual was identified via surveillance and cited for a retail theft that occurred in the 400 block of East Verona Avenue.
Today's flavor of the day is Double Strawberry, and the store is currently open until 10:00 PM, so there is plenty of time to stop by for a treat.
